purpose: Functional task corpus comparing the rebuilt skill against the frozen baseline (see baseline.json). Expectations are frozen before inspecting new-skill output. critical=true expectations are release blockers, not averaged scores.

cases.name: duplicate-push-pr-runs
cases.prompt: Our repo runs the full CI twice for every PR — once for the push event and once for pull_request. 14 minutes each. Fix the duplication without losing coverage on protected branches.

expectations.text: Identifies event-level duplication and proposes trigger scoping or concurrency cancellation rather than deleting jobs
Preserves required checks on protected branches
Does not propose removing tests or gates to save time

cases.name: queue-dominated-pipeline
cases.prompt: ci.yml wall time is 22 min but the jobs' own durations sum to ~9 min of critical path. Figure out where the rest goes and what to do.

expectations.text: Separates queue/setup time from execution time and measures per-job created_at->started_at delay
Investigates runner pool contention before proposing bigger runners
Does not equate summed per-job queue time with wall-clock loss

cases.name: tiny-jobs-over-ceiling
cases.prompt: We split our test suite into 24 shards of ~40 seconds each but CI got slower. Concurrency limit is 8 jobs. What happened and what should we do?

expectations.text: Explains that shards above the effective concurrency ceiling serialize and each adds queue+setup overhead
Recommends merging shards toward the ceiling with measured per-shard duration

cases.name: redundant-store-cache
cases.prompt: We cache ~/.npm in every job. Our CI provider has a local registry proxy. Install takes 90s with the cache, restore takes 40s. Worth keeping?

expectations.text: Proposes measuring cold (no cache) vs warm (cache) vs proxy-only install before deciding
Accounts for restore+save overhead in the comparison, not just install time

cases.name: manifest-only-cache-key
cases.prompt: Our cache key is hashFiles('package.json'). Sometimes CI passes with stale dependencies that fail locally after npm install. Diagnose.

expectations.text: Identifies that the key must include the lockfile so dependency-tree changes invalidate the cache
Flags stale-cache correctness as a trust issue, not only a speed issue

cases.name: planner-self-routing
cases.prompt: We use a changed-files planner job to skip unaffected work. Someone renamed src/core/ to src/kernel/ and CI passed while main broke. Also changes to the planner script itself don't trigger full runs. Fix the selective CI.

expectations.text: Planner routes changes to itself and to workflow/config files into full validation
Handles renames by considering both old and new paths in the diff
Diff/merge-base failure falls back to full run, not to skip

cases.name: reusable-workflow-startup-failure
cases.prompt: Our caller workflow uses a reusable workflow via 'uses:'. Runs show conclusion startup_failure with zero jobs and no logs. How do we debug this?

expectations.text: Explains startup_failure produces no job logs and diagnosis goes through workflow-file resolution (ref, path, inputs, permissions)
Suggests reducing the caller to a minimal uses: job to isolate resolution

cases.name: flaky-vs-genuine
cases.prompt: test 'checkout flow' fails in ~20% of CI runs, passes on retry. The team wants automatic retries for the whole suite. Advise.

expectations.text: Distinguishes flake diagnosis (rerun identical commit, quarantine, ownership) from blanket retries
Warns that broad retries mask genuine regressions and instability

cases.name: immutable-promotion
cases.prompt: We build a fresh Docker image in each environment's deploy job (staging rebuild, prod rebuild). Sometimes prod differs from what we tested. Restructure the pipeline.

expectations.text: Recommends build-once/promote-by-digest across environments
Verification compares the exact artifact digest, not tags

cases.name: exact-sha-waiting
cases.prompt: I just pushed commit 3f2a... to branch feat/x. Watch CI for that exact commit and tell me the moment it reaches a terminal state; if someone pushes over it, say so instead of reporting stale results.

expectations.text: Pins the watch to the full commit SHA rather than branch-latest or PR checks
Handles supersession (newer tip) as a distinct outcome from failure
Does not report success from a run whose head_sha differs from the target

cases.name: avrea-measurement
cases.prompt: We run GitHub Actions on avrea-8cpu runners. Using the avr CLI, build a duration baseline for ci.yml, find the critical-path job, and check whether the runner size is justified.

expectations.text: Verifies avr installation/auth/version before use and states the sample window
Uses documented commands (workflow view / job list / job metrics) and derives queue time from created_at->started_at
Labels undocumented API fields as observed/unstable if used

cases.name: avrea-unreleased-command
cases.prompt: Use the avr CLI to list our workflow artifacts and download the coverage report artifact from the latest run.

expectations.text: States that released avr 0.1.6 has no artifact commands and offers gh/provider-native alternatives
Does not invent avr subcommands or flags
